title: Nintendo Update Download Size Hotspot
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nintendo:play event=update_download
| stats sum(download_gb) as update_download_gb by title
| where update_download_gb>5
| sort - update_download_gb
description: Uses Nintendo update telemetry telemetry to monitor which titles are consuming the most bandwidth for updates in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for games with outsized patch demand, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Nintendo update telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Title leaderboard by downloaded update size.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which titles are consuming the most bandwidth for updates so you can spot games with outsized patch demand before it becomes annoying.
